svg.aria-label: Sandboxes held across six machines and kept in memory by heap size, beside latency by idle time and under traffic

g.text: Created at 20/s; 1,198 of 1,200 sampled then answered.
64 MiB heap. Frozen after 15 s idle, on disk after 60 s.
Kept in memory per node; under each, its wake from disk.
40 per node, where about 12 fit awake. Zipf popularity.
